question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the highlighted word.

The moral values in this nation were at their __**nadir**__** **during the autocrat’s rule.
solution:
The correct answer is **"base"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nadir** means the point at which something is at its lowest value or level.

 
 
• **Example: ***At its **nadir** in the mid-1980s, the pound was almost at parity with the dollar. *
 
 
 
• **Base** means the lowest part or edge of something.
 
 
• **Example:** *She sat down at the **base **of a tree.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
